hospital-platform.title: Healthcare Operations Concept
hospital-platform.tagline: Connected digital workflows for modern healthcare operations.
hospital-platform.statement: A shared operations platform for multi-department hospitals — one patient record, role-based dashboards, and coordinated scheduling.
hospital-platform.description: The problem explored: a multi-department hospital tracking patient records, scheduling, and staff access across disconnected spreadsheets and paper logs.
highlights: One patient record shared across departments instead of re-entered at each desk
Dashboards scoped by role, so a nurse and a billing clerk see only what applies to them
Appointment scheduling that respects each department's own hours and staff availability
hospital-platform.demonstrates: How we'd structure role-based access and a shared data model across departments that don't normally share systems.

school-erp.title: Education Management Concept
school-erp.tagline: Connected school operations across academics, attendance, fees and communication.
school-erp.statement: A connected school operations platform bringing attendance, fees and parent communication into one shared system.
school-erp.description: The problem explored: attendance, fees, and parent communication handled through separate tools that don't talk to each other.
highlights: A single attendance record that drives fee status and parent notifications automatically
Parent-teacher portal scoped to one child's data, not the whole school's
Role-based access so a teacher, an accountant, and a parent each see a different view
school-erp.demonstrates: How we'd design one data model that serves three different user types without exposing data they shouldn't see.

restaurant-website.title: Restaurant Web Presence Concept
restaurant-website.description: The problem explored: a restaurant losing reservations to a slow, desktop-first site when most visits happen on a phone at dinner time.
highlights: Menu structured for one-thumb browsing, not a scanned PDF
Reservation request flow that works in under 30 seconds on mobile
Page structure built around local search intent, not generic copy
restaurant-website.demonstrates: How we'd prioritize mobile load speed and conversion structure for a location-based business.

real-estate-crm.title: Real Estate Operations Concept
real-estate-crm.tagline: A connected property workflow from lead capture through deal management.
real-estate-crm.statement: A shared pipeline for real estate teams — one view of every lead, listing and follow-up, with nothing sitting untouched.
real-estate-crm.description: The problem explored: a sales team losing track of which lead was last contacted, and by whom, across a shared inbox and a spreadsheet.
highlights: One pipeline view so no lead sits untouched without the team noticing
Listing management tied directly to the leads attached to it
Follow-up visibility shared across the team, not locked to one agent's inbox
real-estate-crm.demonstrates: How we'd design a shared pipeline that stays accurate without extra manual logging.

business-website.title: Business Website Concept
business-website.description: The problem explored: a service business whose site describes what they do but gives visitors no clear next step.
highlights: Page structure built around one clear action per screen, not a wall of text
Lead capture placed where intent is highest, not just in the footer
Technical SEO handled at build time, not bolted on afterward
business-website.demonstrates: How we'd structure a site around a single conversion goal instead of trying to say everything at once.

ai-saas-dashboard.title: SaaS Administration Concept
ai-saas-dashboard.tagline: A focused command center for complex SaaS systems and operational data.
ai-saas-dashboard.statement: A multi-tenant admin console with isolated customer data and AI-assisted actions scoped to what each tenant actually owns.
ai-saas-dashboard.description: The problem explored: an admin dashboard for a multi-tenant product where every customer's data has to stay isolated while the AI features stay useful.
highlights: Tenant isolation enforced at the data layer, not just hidden in the UI
AI-assisted actions scoped to the data the requesting tenant actually owns
Usage analytics built as a first-class feature, not an afterthought query
ai-saas-dashboard.demonstrates: How we'd approach multi-tenant data isolation and where AI features should — and shouldn't — have access.

ecommerce-platform.title: Retail & eCommerce Concept
ecommerce-platform.tagline: A commerce platform built around product discovery, checkout and everyday operations.
ecommerce-platform.statement: A unified commerce platform where catalog, checkout and order data share one source of truth instead of three disconnected tools.
ecommerce-platform.description: The problem explored: a growing retail business managing products, orders and payments across a storefront, a spreadsheet and a separate payment dashboard that don't share data.
highlights: One product catalog powering the storefront, inventory and checkout together
A checkout flow designed around conversion, not just payment processing
Order and customer data unified in one place instead of split across spreadsheets
ecommerce-platform.demonstrates: How we'd structure a single commerce data model that keeps catalog, checkout and fulfillment in sync.

travel-platform.title: Travel & Hospitality Concept
travel-platform.tagline: A booking platform built around guest journeys, from search to stay.
travel-platform.statement: A booking and itinerary platform that keeps guest details, availability and communication tied to one shared record.
travel-platform.description: The problem explored: a travel or hospitality business managing bookings, guest communication and availability across a booking inbox, a spreadsheet and manual follow-ups.
highlights: A single booking flow that captures guest details once and reuses them everywhere
Real-time availability shared across the team instead of a manually updated spreadsheet
Itinerary and guest communication tied to the same booking record
travel-platform.demonstrates: How we'd design a booking system that stays accurate without manual double-entry between tools.

premium-school-website.title: Premium K–12 School Website
premium-school-website.metaTitle: Premium K–12 School Website Concept | Novyra Technologies
premium-school-website.metaDescription: Explore a premium K–12 school website concept by Novyra Technologies, designed around admissions, academics, facilities, campus life and a modern parent experience.
premium-school-website.tagline: A parent-first digital experience that makes admissions, academics, facilities and school life easier to discover.
premium-school-website.description: A premium parent-first K–12 school website concept designed around admissions, academics, learning stages, facilities, campus life and clear parent communication.
highlights: A hero built around the parent's real question — classes offered, admissions status and one clear enquiry action
Trust signals (CBSE affiliation, safe campus, future-ready learning) placed where the decision actually happens, not buried in an About page
Class-range navigation and a campus-visit path designed for a five-minute evaluation, not a full read
premium-school-website.demonstrates: How we'd structure a school's public website around the parent decision journey instead of an internal staff-first sitemap.
premium-school-website.challenge: Schools often have large amounts of information, but parents need a clear path to understand the school and reach admission information.
premium-school-website.approach: The experience organizes information around one path — Discover the school, Understand its academics and stages, Explore facilities and campus life, then Enquire. A hero states curriculum and admissions status immediately, a learning-stage picker (Nursery through Class 12) gets a parent to relevant information in one tap, and every section leads back to the same enquiry action.

admission-focused-school-website.title: Admission-Focused School Website
admission-focused-school-website.tagline: A cinematic, admissions-first school experience built to turn campus interest into applications.
admission-focused-school-website.description: The problem explored: competing schools all claim excellence in text — an admissions page needs to make the case visually and immediately, or it blends into every other school site a parent has open in another tab.
highlights: Full-bleed campus photography and an 'Admissions Open' status badge doing the credibility work a paragraph usually tries to
A virtual tour placed as an equal option next to 'Apply Now,' for parents who aren't ready to commit yet
Track-record numbers (years of excellence, board pass rate) placed directly in the hero, not several scrolls down
admission-focused-school-website.demonstrates: How we'd design an admissions-first hero that leads with visual credibility instead of a wall of claims.
admission-focused-school-website.challenge: Every school claims small class sizes and strong results — an admissions page has to earn belief in seconds, before a parent reads a single paragraph.
admission-focused-school-website.approach: Led with cinematic campus photography and a live admissions-cycle badge, paired an 'Apply Now' action with a lower-commitment 'Virtual Tour' path, and surfaced track-record numbers directly in the hero rather than in a separate stats section.

preschool-website.title: Preschool & Early Learning Website
preschool-website.tagline: A warm, playful digital experience designed for parents choosing early childhood care.
preschool-website.description: The problem explored: parents choosing a preschool are evaluating warmth and trust as much as curriculum — a generic corporate template undersells the caregiving experience a young child actually needs.
highlights: Soft, rounded visual language and a playful color and type system that reads as childcare, not corporate SaaS
Low teacher-to-child ratio and care-first messaging surfaced in the hero, ahead of curriculum detail
Real parent trust signals (family photos, a simple rating line) placed next to the primary enrollment action
preschool-website.demonstrates: How we'd design for a caregiving decision rather than a features comparison — warmth first, curriculum second.
preschool-website.challenge: A preschool's website is often the first impression a parent forms of how a school treats young children — a stiff, corporate layout undermines that before a single word is read.
preschool-website.approach: Used a soft, rounded visual language and a warm color system built for the audience (parents of children under 6), led the hero with care-first messaging and low teacher-to-child ratios, and placed enrollment and trust signals side by side rather than trust signals buried below the fold.

modern-hospital-website.title: Modern Hospital Website
modern-hospital-website.tagline: A trust-first hospital experience built around emergency access, Ayushman eligibility and appointment booking.
modern-hospital-website.description: The problem explored: in an urgent-care decision, a visitor needs emergency contact, government-scheme eligibility and an appointment path within seconds — not buried three menu levels down.
highlights: A persistent emergency call action and a live '24/7 Open Now' status, not a hidden contact page
Ayushman Bharat eligibility given its own dedicated section instead of a single line in the FAQ
Department and doctor directory plus a WhatsApp path built for one-thumb mobile use, since most urgent visits start on a phone
modern-hospital-website.demonstrates: How we'd prioritize emergency and eligibility information architecture for a healthcare site where seconds matter.
modern-hospital-website.challenge: Hospital websites tend to organize around internal departments; a visitor in an urgent-care moment needs emergency contact and eligibility information immediately, not the hospital's org chart.
modern-hospital-website.approach: Put a 24/7 emergency call action and live status badge in the hero alongside appointment booking, gave Ayushman Bharat eligibility its own trust-building section with a 'Check My Eligibility' path, and built the department/doctor directory and WhatsApp contact for fast mobile use.

fintech-platform.title: Finance & FinTech Concept
fintech-platform.tagline: A secure product for modern financial workflows and reporting.
fintech-platform.statement: A secure financial operations product with clear reporting, workflow-based approvals and an audit trail built in from day one.
fintech-platform.description: The problem explored: a financial services team managing reporting, approvals and compliance across spreadsheets, email threads and manual review.
highlights: Clear, real-time dashboards for financial reporting and analytics
Workflow-based approvals in place of email-driven sign-off chains
Audit-ready activity logs built in from the start, not added later
fintech-platform.demonstrates: How we'd approach secure data handling, approvals and reporting for a financial workflow.
